description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - A. Balasuppiramaniyam was declared as the Vice Chairman of the Kotagala Pradeshiya Sabaha
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the declaration of a Vice Chairman for a local government authority (Kotagala Pradeshiya Sabha) under Section 66g of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It is directly related to electoral processes and the composition of elected local government bodies, falling clearly within the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including candidate declarations and results.
